  h:additionalInfo: If you FOUND an ID, hand it to the guard office (the Guard House at the main gate, on the left as you enter) or to the student council (the Supreme Student Council or your college's student council), who can return it to its owner.

  h:additionalInfo: The Handbook requires wearing the University ID at all times on campus (not doing so is a minor offense), so replace it as soon as you can.
  h:additionalInfo: You bring your Certificate of Registration (COR), scan the QR code or fill out the Google Form, wait for your data to be encoded and the ID printed, then sign the logbook.

The steps for processing your student ID are as follows:
